claims.text: For \(\mathfrak S_v=s_{i^j}\), the source states that \(J_v\subseteq\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is generated by \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\). [source-2@L1354-L1375|claim=formal-document]

Under the explicit box-Schur realization \(I_{r,q}=\bigoplus_{\lambda\not\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Zs_\lambda\), the requested restriction \(J_{p,c}\twoheadrightarrow J_{1,1}\) and its descent to indecomposables are established for every \(i,j,p,c\ge1\).
